title: ATHENA 3.5.0 — Collective Generalized V16 × UNIFIED.12 × Deployment.2

v16_contracts: ordered DAG posterior enumerates only the caller-topological-order-constrained finite linear-Gaussian BIC/edge-prior family
multistage cross-fitted sequential DR supports only one to six binary treatment stages with explicit caller-declared histories
Gaussian-mixture update is exact only for the supplied finite mixture and shared linear-Gaussian observation
learned approximation-error field reports an RBF prediction plus held-out residual quantile and explicit witness support distance
coupled model robust policy exactly evaluates only a supplied finite policy set across a supplied finite family of complete models with one model fixed over the whole horizon
all V16 operators remain model/science/control state and do not acquire Y1, JSPACE, execution, deployment, release-publication, or trust authority by adjacency

gates: automatic validation on every master push without publication
non-PR package-readiness requires release head equals current origin/master
manual workflow_dispatch remains the only publication trigger
package/version/server/manifest release identity all equal 3.5.0 / UNIFIED.12
critical invariant selectors resolve to real nonempty test files
ordered-DAG family and caller-order claim ceiling regression
six-stage longitudinal history and identification firewall regression
finite Gaussian-mixture scope and unknown-coordinate regression
error-field OOD/support and residual-quantile claim ceiling regression
coupled finite-model supplied-policy robust evaluation claim ceiling regression
UNIFIED.12 manifest identity across public manifest paths
V15 and V16 science/control tool/resource retention
V16 outputs cannot mutate Y1/JSPACE/empirical observations/execution/deployment/release/trust by adjacency
release attestation binds exact commit plus trusted PROMRUN receipt
authority_boundaries: GitHub release publication is distribution, not deployment.

Every master push is admitted to V3.5 validation, but master-push validation does not publish a tag or GitHub release; package-readiness on push is candidate evidence only, and publication remains manual workflow_dispatch authority.

Release attestation certifies exact repository/package/distribution-candidate state, not empirical truth, causal identification, world-model correctness or robust-control optimality outside the implemented finite model.
An ordered-DAG posterior is not a general causal graph posterior and the caller-declared order is not discovered causal truth.
Cross-fitted multistage DR over at most six binary treatment stages does not establish arbitrary-horizon longitudinal identification or treatment authority.
A finite Gaussian-mixture posterior is not general non-Gaussian Bayes or world truth.
A cross-validated residual quantile from the learned error field is not a distribution-free coverage certificate or global regularity theorem.
Exact evaluation of supplied policies over a finite coupled model family is not general non-rectangular DRO optimization and does not prove the real world lies in the model family.
Trusted PROMOTION.2 qualification is not GitHub administrative hardening.
A tag or release does not authorize treatment execution, production secrets, infrastructure mutation, external package-index publication, production traffic, or Y1 mutation.
Deployment.2 remains external-control planning and receipt verification, not proof that production infrastructure changed.
A V3.4 release attestation, package candidate, or V15 cold-boot receipt is historical evidence and is not evidence for V3.5/V16 bytes.
